summary: Destructor for a UI control object. Restores the vtable pointer, conditionally frees a child resource pointer when it is non-null, then frees the object itself when the low bit of the destruction flag is set.

operations.description: If this[1] (offset 0x4) is non-null, enter the child-resource free path.
FreeWrapper_7bcf(this[1]) frees the child resource pointed to at offset 0x4.
If (a2 & 1) is set, the object itself is freed.

unresolved: The exact class owning this destructor is not established; off_5A443C is only labeled VTable_ControlBase (DERIVED).
Whether the low bit of a2 has call-site meaning (e.g. delete-vs-destroy flag) is unknown.
